# Nikko Homecare

> Nikko Homecare is a home care and nursing provider in Nairobi, Kenya, founded by Alice Gachui, with over 10 years of experience. It provides professional nurses and caregivers for the elderly, the sick, the terminally ill, people recovering from surgery and persons living with disabilities, either in their own homes across Nairobi or at the Nikko residence on Nandi Road, Karen. Nurses are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

- Address: Hse 128, Nandi Road, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone: +254 726 440 428
- Email: care@nikkohomecare.co.ke
- Hours: Always open (24/7)
- Area served: Nairobi and surrounding areas
- How to start: book a consultation by phone or through the contact page

## Services

- [Elderly care](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): personal care, meals, medication reminders, mobility and companionship at home
- [Skilled nursing](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): registered nurses for medication, monitoring and wound care; hourly, overnight or live-in
- [Home-based medical care](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): nursing for chronic illness, disability and terminal illness, coordinated with doctors
- [Physiotherapy and therapy](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech therapy, at home or at the residence
- [Palliative and hospice care](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): comfort-focused care with family support
- [Post-surgery recovery](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): wound care, medication support and safe mobility after hospital
- [Respite care](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): short stays or home visits so family caregivers can rest
- [Medical examinations, diagnostics and lab tests](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/)
- [Ambulance services](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): supported transfers to hospital
- [Counselling](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): support for clients and families
- [Caregiver training](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/services/): training for students and families in caregiving, patient care and community health

## Residence

- [Our residence in Karen](https://nikkohomecare.co.ke/our-residence/): private and shared rooms, medical room, shared lounge, garden, nurses on duty 24/7; for respite, recovery and longer-term care
